verdict.rationale: Conductor runs coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode locally on your machine, using your local installation and local git worktrees. Each workspace includes its own terminal. However, it is a Mac GUI app, not a terminal-launched tool, and one user notes the native Claude Code terminal feel is lost. Missing for 10: a documented CLI to launch or drive agents from the user's own terminal, non-Mac support, and independent hands-on confirmation of a terminal-driven workflow.
